_comment: Batch strings-0 (src/strings.c part 0). Width allowances verified against the window templates cited in each _why entry.
_why src/strings.c:gText_ExpandedPlaceho: string_util.c ExpandPlaceholder_*: expanded inline into message text, no window of their own; tools/textcheck measures {VERSION}/{AQUA}/{MAGMA}/{ARCHIE}/{MAXIE}/{KYOGRE}/{GROUDON} with the real width of these strings, so the containing text is checked there. Sapphire/Ruby unused; Red/Green only under IS_FRLG.

string_util.c ExpandPlaceholder_RivalName ({RIVAL}, textcheck assumes 7 chars = 42px), trainer_fan_club.c (StringCopy to gStringVar1) and pokenav_match_call_data.c .name (match call list, where longer trainer names such as Fiammetta also appear).
_why src/strings.c:gText_EggNickname: u8 gText_EggNickname[POKEMON_NAME_LENGTH + 1]; copied as the nickname of eggs (pokemon.c, pokemon_storage_system.c, ...), shown wherever a 12-char nickname is shown: 12 x 6px.
_why src/strings.c:gText_Player,gText_Ba: Unused: no reference outside src/strings.c and include/strings.h (grep over src/ include/).
_why src/strings.c:gText_Time: hall_of_fame.c HallOfFame_PrintPlayerInfo: window sHof_WindowTemplate 14 tiles = 112px; label at x=0, play time right-aligned to x=0x70 (6 chars ~36px), so >= 70px free.
_why src/strings.c:gText_Next,gText_Next: oak_speech.c (FRLG intro): HofPCTopBar_Print/PrintPair, top bar window 30 tiles = 240px, FONT_SMALL, right-aligned next to gText_Controls.
_why src/strings.c:gText_PickNextCancel: hall_of_fame.c HofPCTopBar_PrintPair(gText_HOFNumber, gText_PickNextCancel): top bar 30 tiles = 240px, FONT_SMALL; small widths 89 + 107 px fit.
_why src/strings.c:gText_Boy,gText_Girl: main_menu.c NewGameBirchSpeech_ShowGenderMenu: sNewGameBirchSpeechTextWindows[1] width 6 tiles = 48px, PrintMenuTable x=8 -> 40px.
_why src/strings.c:gText_ThisIsAPokemon: main_menu.c: sNewGameBirchSpeechTextWindows[0] width 27 tiles = 216px, AddTextPrinterForMessage x=0; line ends in \p, minus 8px down arrow.
_why src/strings.c:gText_CryOf: pokedex.c / pokedex_plus_hgss.c cry screen: PrintInfoScreenText(gText_CryOf, 82, 33) in WIN_INFO (32 tiles); the species name (up to 12 chars) is printed below at the same x, so 80px is free.
_why src/strings.c:gText_SizeComparedTo: pokedex.c / pokedex_plus_hgss.c size screen: player name (<= 7 chars) appended, whole string centered in DISPLAY_WIDTH (240px) of WIN_INFO (32 tiles).
_why src/strings.c:gText_WelcomeToHOF: hall_of_fame.c HallOfFame_PrintWelcomeText: centered with GetStringCenterAlignXOffset(..., 0xD0) in window 0.
_why src/strings.c:gText_HOFCorrupted,gT: hall_of_fame.c: window 0 = standard text box (LoadHofBgs -> InitStandardTextBoxWindows, menu.c sStandardTextBox_WindowTemplates 27 tiles = 216px), AddTextPrinterParameterized2 x=0.
_why src/strings.c:gText_FlyToWhere: region_map.c sFlyMapWindowTemplates[WIN_FLY_TO_WHERE] width 14 tiles = 112px, printed at x=0.
_why src/strings.c:gMenuText_Toss,gText_: Tightest use: pokeblock.c sWindowTemplates[WIN_ACTIONS] width 6 tiles = 48px, PrintMenuActionTextsInUpperLeftCorner x=8 (FONT_NORMAL) -> 40px. Bag/pyramid context menus use FONT_NARROW with option width 56 at x=8; party cancel button FONT_SMALL centered in 48; other lists/menus are wider or sized dynamically.
_why src/strings.c:gMenuText_Confirm: item_menu.c PrintContextMenuItemGrid: FONT_NARROW, option width 56 at x=8 -> 48px; party_menu.c confirm button: FONT_SMALL centered in 48px.
_why src/strings.c:gText_None: pokemon_summary_screen.c: held item centered in 72px (PSS_DATA_WINDOW_SKILLS_HELD_ITEM 10 tiles), ribbon count centered in 70px; dexnav.c prints it in FONT_SMALL where ability names go.
_why src/strings.c:gText_CloseBag: item_menu.c / battle_pyramid_bag.c: last entry of the item list (WIN_ITEM_LIST / WIN_LIST 15 tiles = 120px, item_X = 8, FONT_NARROW) where 19-char item names are printed.
_why src/strings.c:gText_Var1IsSelected,: item_menu.c WIN_DESCRIPTION / shop.c WIN_ITEM_DESCRIPTION: 14 tiles = 112px, printed at x=3. The item name in gText_Var1IsSelected is font-fitted to 96px (WrapFontIdToFit).
_why src/strings.c:gText_TheField,gText_: Inserted as STR_VAR_1 into gText_ReturnToVar1 line 2 ("{STR_VAR_1}.") in the bag/pyramid description window (14 tiles = 112px, x=3).
_why src/strings.c:gText_ThrewAwayVar2Va: Tightest window: player_pc.c ITEMPC_WIN_MESSAGE 13 tiles = 104px, x=0. STR_VAR_2 is a quantity of <= MAX_ITEM_DIGITS (3) digits = 18px, not the assumed 60px: real width of line 1 = 82px; STR_VAR_1 (line 2) is font-fitted to the window.
_why src/strings.c:gText_CantWriteMail,g: item_menu.c DisplayItemMessage: sContextMenuWindowTemplates[ITEMWIN_MESSAGE] 27 tiles = 216px, x=0 (battle_pyramid_bag.c WIN_MSG is also 27 tiles).
_why src/strings.c:gText_RepelEffectsLin: item_use.c: DisplayItemMessage (ITEMWIN_MESSAGE 27 tiles = 216px) or pyramid WIN_MSG (27 tiles), x=0; last line carries the down arrow ({PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS}) -> 208.
_why src/strings.c:gText_ShopBuy,gText_S: shop.c: menu window width computed with GetMaxWidthInMenuTable, PrintMenuTable x=8; nothing else on that row.
_why src/strings.c:gText_ThankYouIllSend: shop.c BuyMenuDisplayMessage: sShopBuyMenuWindowTemplates[WIN_MESSAGE] 27 tiles = 216px, x=0. In gText_ThrowInPremierBalls STR_VAR_1 is a 1-digit count (real width -54px).
_why src/strings.c:gText_SpAtk3,gText_Sp: party_menu.c ItemEffectToStatString: copied into a STR_VAR for party WIN_MSG messages (textcheck counts a STR_VAR as 60px).
_why src/strings.c:gText_CantSwitchWithA: party_menu.c DisplayPartyMenuMessage/PrintMessage: data/party_menu.h [WIN_MSG] width 28 tiles = 224px (single/double/multi templates), AddTextPrinterParameterized2 x=0; 216 leaves room for the 8px down arrow.
_why src/strings.c:gText_EggCantBeTraded: trade.c PrintTradeMessage: data/trade.h sWindowTemplates[0] width 22 tiles = 176px, x=0 (also shown in party WIN_MSG, 224px).
_why src/strings.c:gText_TeachWhichPokem: party_menu.c DisplayPartyMenuStdMessage default: data/party_menu.h sDefaultPartyMsgWindowTemplate width 21 tiles = 168px, x=0 (gText_TeachWhichPokemon2 is unused).
_why src/strings.c:gText_WhichAppliance: data/party_menu.h sOrderWhichApplianceMsgWindowTemplate width 14 tiles = 112px, height 4 (2 lines), x=0.
_why src/strings.c:gText_NoUse,gText_Abl: party_menu.c DisplayPartyPokemonDescriptionText (sDescriptionStringTable): data/party_menu.h sPartyBoxInfoRects description rect width 64px (left column x=12 in a 10-tile window, right column x=77 in an 18-tile window).
_why src/strings.c:gText_Attack3: pokemon_summary_screen.c PrintPageNamesAndStats: left stat labels centered in 42px at x=6 (PSS_LABEL_WINDOW_POKEMON_SKILLS_STATS_LEFT 6 tiles).
_why src/strings.c:gText_Power: pokemon_summary_screen.c: PSS_LABEL_WINDOW_MOVES_POWER_ACC, label at x=0, value printed at x=53; HGSS dex: FONT_SMALL label at x=8, value at x=53.
_why src/strings.c:gText_Jam: pokemon_summary_screen.c PSS_LABEL_WINDOW_MOVES_APPEAL_JAM width 5 tiles = 40px, x=0; HGSS dex: FONT_SMALL label at x=74, value at x=122.
_why src/strings.c:gText_NextLv: pokemon_summary_screen.c PSS_LABEL_WINDOW_POKEMON_SKILLS_EXP width 11 tiles = 88px, printed at x=6; the values are in PSS_DATA_WINDOW_EXP (tile 24).
_why src/strings.c:gText_Switch: pokemon_summary_screen.c ShowUtilityPrompt: right-aligned to x=62 in an 8-tile window with the 16px button icon before it -> text <= 46px.
_why src/strings.c:gText_EggWillTakeALon: pokemon_summary_screen.c PrintEggState: sPageInfoTemplate[PSS_DATA_WINDOW_INFO_ABILITY] width 18 tiles = 144px, height 4, x=0.
_why src/strings.c:gText_XNatureMetAtYZ,: pokemon_summary_screen.c PrintMonTrainerMemo: sPageInfoTemplate[PSS_DATA_WINDOW_INFO_MEMO] width 18 tiles = 144px, height 6 (3 lines), x=0; {DYNAMIC 3} (met level, <= 3 digits = 18px) measures 0 here -> 144 - 18.
_why src/strings.c:gText_XNatureObtained: pokemon_summary_screen.c PrintMonTrainerMemo / PrintEggMemo: PSS_DATA_WINDOW_INFO_MEMO width 18 tiles = 144px, x=0 (no level on the line).
_why src/strings.c:gText_Desk,gText_Chai: decoration.c PrintDecorationCategoryMenuItem: sDecorationWindowTemplates[1] 13 tiles = 104px, name at x=8, count "nn/nn" (~30px) right-aligned to 104.
_why src/strings.c:gText_Toss2: decoration.c: main menu window width from GetMaxWidthInMenuTable (capped at 18 tiles), PrintMenuTable x=8.
_why src/strings.c:gText_Silver,gText_Go: fldeff_misc.c InteractWithShieldOrTVDecoration: StringCopy to gStringVar2 for a msgbox text (STR_VAR = 60px in textcheck).
_why src/strings.c:gText_PkmnLearnedMove: chooseboxmon.c LearnMove ui->printMessage: field_specials.c UIPrintMessage -> ShowFieldMessage (27 tiles = 216px) and move_relearner.c UIPrintMessage -> menu_specialized.c MoveRelearnerPrintMessage, RELEARNERWIN_MSG width 22 tiles = 176px, x=0 (gText_12PoofForgotMove also party WIN_MSG 224px).
_why src/strings.c:gText_TossHowManyVar1: Tightest window: player_pc.c ITEMPC_WIN_MESSAGE 13 tiles = 104px, x=0 (bag WIN_DESCRIPTION / pyramid WIN_INFO: 14 tiles, x=3 -> 109px). STR_VAR_1 is font-fitted (WrapFontIdToFit) to 96-98px and sits alone on line 1 with ":".
